scientific_limitations: The theorem treats ordinary three-cut complexes of Cartesian products of two cycles, each of length at least five. It classifies integral homology of the original cut complex and the homotopy type of its Alexander dual; it does not classify the original homotopy type or other cut conventions.
title: Toroidal three-cut complexes retain an integral fundamental-surface class
